item.title: Dangote Refinery Lowers Minimum Petrol Purchase Volume
item.description: Dangote Petroleum Refinery, Africa’s largest single-train facility owned by the Dangote Group, has reduced the minimum bulk purchase volume for petrol from 500,000 litres to 250,000 litres.
